name: store_byte_and_advance_cursor
description: Copies one byte from the caller's parameter block to the location the write cursor points at, moves the cursor forward by one byte, and returns that byte.

name: apply_routine_to_record_table
description: Steps through a fixed table of 22-byte records from its first entry up to its end, calling another routine once for each record's address.

name: release_record_fields
description: For a null record it returns the all-ones failure value. Otherwise, when the record's flag byte is set, it releases the buffers that the flags mark as in use, then clears the record's three longword fields and flag byte, returning the combined status.

name: release_record_in_place
description: Works on the record at the address register: when its flag byte is set it releases the buffers that the flags mark as in use, then clears the three longword fields and the flag byte, returning the combined status.

name: write_byte_to_buffered_stream
description: Writes one byte into a buffered output stream whose state lives in a parameter record. A stream already in error returns the failure value; the end sentinel resets the stream without writing; a single-byte buffer writes through a temporary and marks the stream in error on failure.

name: write_stream_byte_flushing
description: Writes one byte into a buffered stream from register-held arguments. An active buffer that is full is flushed through another routine first, and the sentinel value resets the stream instead of writing.

name: write_stream_byte_or_clear
description: Writes one byte to a buffered stream from register-held arguments. The end sentinel clears the stream and returns zero; otherwise the buffer is initialised if it has no start, and a single-byte buffer writes through a temporary, marking the stream in error on failure.

name: write_stream_byte_unchecked
description: Writes one byte to a buffered stream, first initialising the buffer if it has no start. A single-byte buffer writes through a temporary byte, and a failed write marks the stream in error; the end sentinel is not tested here.

name: start_stream_with_first_byte
description: Resets a buffered stream so its write position is its start and its end is the start plus the buffer size, marks the stream active, and writes the first byte from the parameter record, returning that byte.

name: find_free_record_slot
description: Scans the fixed table of 22-byte records from its first entry and returns the first record whose flag byte is clear, after zeroing its three longword fields. It returns nothing when every record is in use.

name: find_free_record_from
description: Starting at the record in the address register, scans forward through the record table for the first unused record, zeroes its three longword fields and returns it, or returns nothing when none is free.

name: zero_record_header_longs
description: Sets the three longword fields at the address register to zero.

name: setup_record_buffer
description: Gives a record its buffer: when the allocation call returns nothing, the record points at a one-byte inline buffer inside itself; otherwise it stores the allocated buffer, marks the record as allocated, and flags it again when a follow-up call returns non-zero.

name: attach_preset_buffer_to_record
description: Configures a record to use a buffer pointer taken from the global data area with a fixed buffer size, marks it as holding a buffer, and flags it further when a follow-up call returns non-zero.

name: release_all_list_nodes
description: Walks a singly linked list from its global head, releasing each node through another routine using the node's stored size plus eight, then clears the head pointer and returns zero.

name: free_list_nodes_from_pointer
description: Releases each node of a singly linked list starting at the node in the address register and stopping after the node whose link is empty, using each node's stored size plus eight, then clears the global head pointer.

name: allocate_and_push_list_node
description: Stores a callback pointer in a global slot, allocates a node sized by the parameter plus eight through a library routine, and on success pushes the node onto the front of the global list and returns the address after its link fields; otherwise it returns nothing.

name: push_node_onto_list
description: Links a node from the parameter record onto the front of the global list, storing the previous head as its link and the record's second field as its payload, then returns the address after the link fields.

name: forward_parameter_field
description: Passes the low word of its single parameter to another routine and returns without further work.

name: unlink_and_release_list_node
description: Searches the global linked list for the node at the given record address minus eight, removes it by relinking its predecessor, and releases it through another routine. It returns zero when the node is found and minus one when it is not.

name: unlink_and_release_from_cursor
description: Walks the linked list from the node in the address register looking for the node at the parameter's record address minus eight. When it finds that node it unlinks it, releases it through another routine using its stored size plus eight, and returns zero; otherwise it returns minus one.

name: unlink_node_from_predecessor
description: Removes a node from a linked list by pointing its predecessor at the node's successor, or at the global head when there is no predecessor, then calls another routine and returns zero.

name: advance_global_list_head
description: Sets the global list head to the link stored in the node at the address register, then calls a library routine and returns zero.

name: dispatch_indexed_table_entry
description: Looks up a six-byte entry in a global table by index. An out-of-range index or an empty entry records error code two and returns minus one; otherwise the entry's pointer is passed to another routine and the result is one when that routine returns non-zero, zero otherwise.

name: test_table_handle_interactive
description: Looks up the six-byte table entry for the index held in the parameter record and reports whether the handle stored there is interactive, using a DOS library call.

name: return_zero_no_op
description: Does nothing except return zero.

name: delete_file_record_error
description: Deletes the file named by its parameter through a DOS library call. On failure it stores the DOS error code in a global error slot and returns minus one; on success it returns zero.

name: return_zero_without_work
description: Returns zero immediately without calling any other routine.

name: call_two_routines_unrecovered
description: The decompiler timed out on this routine, so its behaviour is known only from its size: 19 instructions, two unnamed routines called, and five callers. It has no recovered pseudo-code to describe further.

name: check_mode_then_write
description: Returns error code five and minus one when the handle's access bits are clear. Otherwise it passes the handle and parameter fields to a write routine, and when that returns minus one it stores the DOS error code and returns minus one.

name: write_with_dos_error_capture
description: Writes data through a DOS library call using the handle and parameter fields. When the write returns minus one, it stores the DOS error code in a global error slot and returns minus one.

name: return_without_action
description: Does nothing and returns.

name: test_mask_bit_then_call
description: Calls another routine with a zero argument and a fixed bit mask, then checks that bit in the result. When the bit is set it calls a library routine if a global word is non-zero and returns the result; otherwise it returns zero.

name: call_then_return_zero
description: Calls another routine with no arguments, discards its result, and returns zero.

name: write_fixed_text_then_callback
description: Gets the output handle, writes a four-byte text fragment from a fixed address to it through DOS calls, then runs a further routine.

name: run_optional_hook_then_finish
description: Calls a global hook pointer when one is set, then calls another routine and returns.

name: release_all_resource_tables
description: Releases the program's resource tables: it calls a routine on each entry of the six-byte table and frees that table, runs an optional global hook, frees the saved buffers that are set, and frees the remaining buffer pair or single buffer. It makes a supervisor-mode library call when a flag is set.

name: close_indexed_handle
description: Validates an index into the six-byte handle table, recording error code two and returning minus one for a bad or empty entry. Otherwise it closes the handle through DOS unless its flag high bit is set, clears the entry and returns zero.

name: forward_to_library_routine
description: Calls a routine in a library whose base address is held in a global slot and returns when that routine returns.

name: forward_to_library_entry
description: Calls another library routine through the library base held in the same global slot and returns when it returns.

name: jump_to_library_routine
description: Transfers control to a routine in a library whose base address is held in a global slot, at a fixed offset from that base, and returns when that routine returns.

name: jump_to_library_entry
description: Transfers control to a library routine through the library base held in a global slot, at a fixed offset, and returns when it returns.

name: jump_to_library_routine_two
description: Transfers control to a library routine through the library base held in a global slot, at a fixed offset, and returns when it returns.

name: jump_to_library_routine_three
description: Transfers control to a library routine through the library base held in a global slot, at a fixed offset, and returns when it returns.

name: wait_for_fire_restore_chips
description: Disables interrupts and disk-control bits, sets the background colour to black, then polls the vertical beam and the fire-button line in rounds of 500 checks, calling another routine between rounds. Once the fire button reads pressed it waits for the blitter, restores the saved interrupt, DMA and disk-control values with their enable bits set, and returns zero.

name: fill_ramp_word_table
description: Fills a 128-entry word table in global memory with successive multiples of 44, starting at zero.

name: fill_reciprocal_lookup_table
description: Fills a word table in memory with the quotient of a fixed large constant divided by each index from 256 up to 8191.

name: generate_wrapped_offset_triples
description: Runs 200 rounds producing three 13-bit wrapped values, each derived from the previous one by fixed offsets, and stores each value through a pointer that another routine advances between stores.

name: call_two_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls two other routines one after the other and returns.

name: busy_wait_sixteen_bit_count
description: Spins in a countdown over a 16-bit counter that wraps through its full range, taking a fixed number of steps, before returning.

name: acknowledge_vblank_and_wait
description: Clears the vertical blank interrupt request bit, calls several other routines, then runs a short countdown before returning.

name: project_and_plot_points
description: Advances a table of 3-word points by per-frame offsets with 13-bit wrapping, scales each point through a lookup table into screen coordinates, and sets the matching pixel bit in up to three bitplanes, stopping when the point count runs out.

name: resume_plotting_with_plane_zero
description: Sets the pending pixel in the first bitplane, then continues advancing and plotting the remaining points through the same loop as the main projection routine.

name: resume_plotting_with_plane_one
description: Sets the pending pixel in the second bitplane, then continues advancing and plotting the remaining points through the same loop as the main projection routine.

name: resume_plotting_planes_zero_one
description: Sets the pending pixel in the first and second bitplanes, then continues advancing and plotting the remaining points through the same loop as the main projection routine.

name: resume_plotting_with_plane_two
description: Sets the pending pixel in the third bitplane, then continues advancing and plotting the remaining points through the same loop as the main projection routine.

name: resume_plotting_planes_zero_two
description: Sets the pending pixel in the first and third bitplanes, then continues advancing and plotting the remaining points through the same loop as the main projection routine.

name: resume_plotting_planes_one_two
description: Sets the pending pixel in the second and third bitplanes, then continues advancing and plotting the remaining points through the same loop as the main projection routine.

name: resume_plotting_with_all_planes
description: Sets the pending pixel in all three bitplanes, then continues advancing and plotting the remaining points through the same loop as the main projection routine.

name: advance_offsets_table_index
description: Adds two words from a table at the current index to two global offsets, advances the index by four bytes, and wraps it back to zero when it reaches the end of the table.

name: start_destination_only_blit
description: Waits for the blitter to go idle, points its destination at a stored address, selects the destination channel alone, clears the destination modulo, and starts a fixed-size blit.

name: render_glyph_rows_to_planes
description: Waits for the beam between passes and fills word tables with values from another routine. It also copies each character's eight glyph rows, looked up in a font table indexed by character code minus 32, into a text buffer's bitplane rows, then fills the tables again.

name: fill_frame_tables_over_rounds
description: Runs 17 rounds, each waiting for the beam, filling a 16-word block, a 64-word table and an 8-word block with values produced by another routine, and writing some of those values into a further table.

name: fill_scanline_tables_countdown
description: Runs 48 countdown rounds, each waiting for the beam and filling a 16-word block and a 64-word table with values produced by another routine.

name: interpolate_rgb_colour
description: Blends two 12-bit colour values, each split into three 4-bit channels, by a signed fraction, and returns the blended colour packed back into 12 bits.

name: render_glyph_rows_then_fill
description: Waits for the beam through 16 rounds that fill tables from another routine, renders each character's eight glyph rows from the font table into the bitplane rows of the text buffer, then fills the tables again through 16 more rounds.

name: rotate_bitplane_pointers
description: Rotates the three bitplane buffer pointers, writes the high and low words of each buffer address into the pointer table, stores a set of fixed list entries, and returns a fixed table address.

name: resolve_relative_offset_table
description: Adds a base address to seven fixed slots, then walks a counted list of relative offsets, storing each accumulated absolute pointer into a global array.

name: open_resource_and_add_interrupt
description: Counts one call, opens a resource through a library routine, and if it is available registers an interrupt structure with it. Returns one when the registration call reports success, zero otherwise.

name: bracket_call_with_flag
description: Clears a global flag word to zero, calls another routine, then sets the flag word to minus one.

name: clear_global_block_then_call
description: Clears a global flag word, zeroes 776 bytes of global memory, then calls another routine.

name: service_tick_counter_slots
description: Advances a tick counter and, when it reaches its limit while an enable word is set, calls another routine. Each set slot byte triggers a call to another routine, the first slot is then cleared, and a pending value is moved into the first slot.

name: reset_audio_load_record
description: Silences the four audio channels by clearing their volumes and disabling their interrupts and DMA, copies a 12-byte record selected by an index into global memory, clears 776 bytes of global memory, sets counters from stored values, and calls another routine.

name: open_ciab_and_install_interrupt
description: Opens the CIA-B resource through a library routine and, when that succeeds, fills in the interrupt structure and installs it. Returns one when the install call reports success, zero otherwise.

name: register_musicirq_interrupt
description: Fills in an interrupt structure named musicirq with its callback routine and calls a library routine to install it. Returns one when installation succeeds, zero otherwise.

name: return_one_stub
description: Does nothing except return one.

name: return_doubled_global_byte
description: Returns a 16-bit value formed by repeating one global byte in both halves.

name: compute_and_write_timer_count
description: Computes a timer count by dividing a fixed large constant by a global divisor, using a fixed default when the divisor is zero. It writes the count's two bytes and a control byte to the timer block, then calls another routine and stores its result.

name: silence_audio_and_clear_block
description: Clears 776 bytes of global memory, sets a global control byte, and zeroes the volume of audio channel zero, then returns its input value unchanged.

name: store_pair_and_set_flag
description: Copies one stored word into another global slot, stores the input value into a third slot, and sets a global flag word to one.

name: reset_flag_and_clear_block
description: Clears a global flag word, zeroes 776 bytes of global memory, then calls another routine and returns.

name: service_tick_slots_with_dma
description: Advances a tick counter and services four slot bytes, calling another routine for each set slot, and moves a pending value into the first slot when one is set. It is the same tick service as the earlier copy, reached through a different entry address.

name: select_channel_data_pointer
description: Reads the parameter record for the current channel. When its length field is one it stores the address of another routine with a length of one; otherwise it computes a pointer into a global table from two fields and stores it with the length.

name: service_four_audio_channels
description: Calls two routines, then calls another routine for each of four channel pointers that are non-zero, returns the result of the last one when it is set, and sets a global status word to its top bit only.

name: advance_sequence_step
description: Advances a step counter, and at its limit resets it, moves the sequence index forward with a loop point, and loads four longword values for the next step from a table.

name: load_channel_values_from_table
description: For each of four enabled channels, loads a longword from a table indexed by that channel's stored index and step into the channel's own output slot.

name: call_one_routine_unrecovered
description: The decompiler timed out on this routine, so its behaviour is known only from its size: 12 instructions, one unnamed routine called, and one caller. It has no recovered pseudo-code to describe further.

name: call_through_unrecovered_pointer
description: Calls through a pointer whose target could not be recovered from the jump table, and returns without other work.

name: return_immediately
description: Returns at once without doing any work.

name: store_channel_field_word
description: Stores the word passed in the data register into a fixed field of the channel state block in the base register, then returns.

name: decode_channel_command_byte
description: Decodes a command byte for one audio channel. Marker values take separate paths, while other values update the channel's step value, clear a 62-byte state block and call further routines.

name: bind_channel_table_entry
description: Looks up a table entry for the channel's index. When the entry is empty it calls another routine and clears a status byte. Otherwise it stores the entry and an offset-adjusted value in the channel state, and sets the status byte to all ones.

name: copy_channel_block_into_buffer
description: Copies a block of table data for the channel's index into a destination buffer in 16-byte groups, records the destination and length in the channel state, then clears a status byte.

name: load_channel_record_from_table
description: Selects the table record numbered by the channel index and copies its fields into the channel state block, including its initial step, length and scaling values.

name: copy_channel_timing_fields
description: Copies timing, scaling and volume fields from a table record into the channel state and clears the related counters.

name: clear_channel_playback_state
description: Zeroes several position, length and index fields of a channel state block and clears a status byte.

name: call_four_channel_routines
description: Calls another routine four times in a row, once for each of the four audio channels, and returns.

name: update_channel_tick_state
description: Advances one audio channel by a tick: it applies table-driven offsets, interpolates the level toward a target, updates the playback counters, and clamps the stored volume between 0 and 64. It calls another routine when a sample table entry is set.

name: run_channel_effect_mode
description: When a countdown reaches zero it reloads the countdown and performs one of several sample-editing effects chosen by the channel's effect mode, such as negating a byte, copying with negation, adding a constant, copying a block, adding table data, or calling another routine.

name: call_through_unrecovered_jumptable
description: Calls through a jump table entry whose target could not be recovered, and returns without other work.

name: negate_sample_byte_and_advance
description: Negates the sample byte at the current position, advances that position by one, and wraps it back to the start of the block when it passes the block end.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:Run:0:0136
name: copy_sixteen_longs_then_call
description: Copies 16 longwords from a fixed offset in the data block into the destination named by the stack parameter when one is given, then calls through a stored routine pointer.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:type:0:0000
name: run_program_entry_and_free
description: Program entry point for the type file: it runs its setup routines, calls through a stored function pointer, releases memory through an Exec library call, clears a field and returns.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:L/Ram-Handler:0:0000
name: copy_memory_then_jump_unrecovered
description: Program entry for the handler file: it makes an Exec memory copy library call through the library base, then calls through a jump target that could not be recovered.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:pp:0:0000
name: open_crm_library_then_call
description: Retries opening the CrM.library shared library through an Exec call until the open succeeds, then calls a function at a fixed offset in the opened library.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:DEVS/ramdrive.device:0:026C
name: open_ramdrive_device_unit
description: Opens dos.library, searches the unit list for an entry whose name matches the requested name, and when one is found allocates and initialises that unit's buffer and fields from a template.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:DEVS/ramdrive.device:0:02DA
name: initialise_ramdrive_unit_buffers
description: Takes a unit descriptor, copies its name into a global buffer and up to 16 parameter longwords, computes the unit size, then allocates and initialises the unit's memory and table fields.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:DEVS/ramdrive.device:0:031C
name: copy_block_and_initialise_unit
description: Copies a block of longwords from the source address to the destination address, then computes the unit size and allocates and initialises the unit's memory and fields, returning zero on completion.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:DEVS/ramdrive.device:0:03D4
name: initialise_ramdrive_device
description: Links a new device structure into the global device list and stores pointers to its internal buffers. It then fills a 128-entry table with an incrementing pattern from a fixed signature, clears the rest, and stores a negated checksum of the table.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:DEVS/ramdrive.device:0:0534
name: release_memory_twice
description: Makes two Exec memory-release library calls through the library base held in the global slot, then returns zero.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:DEVS/ramdrive.device:0:057A
name: find_masked_entry_and_call
description: Searches a linked list for an entry whose flag bits include the requested mask and calls a library routine with the best matching value found, returning that routine's result, or zero when nothing matches.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:DEVS/ramdrive.device:0:05BC
name: call_or_search_masked_entry
description: Uses a count it is given: when it is non-zero it calls a library routine with that value. Otherwise it searches a list for an entry whose flag bits match the mask, records the matching value, and returns the result.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:DEVS/ramdrive.device:0:05E2
name: release_interrupt_disable_count
description: Decrements a nesting count of interrupt-disable requests and, when it reaches zero, writes the interrupt enable value that restores the master interrupt switch, then returns zero.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:DEVS/ramdrive.device:0:05E8
name: store_unit_field_return_zero
description: Stores the data-register value into a fixed field of the structure at the address register and returns zero.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:DEVS/ramdrive.device:0:05F0
name: process_device_message
description: Forbids multitasking, dispatches on a message's command field through a table of up to 16 routines, stores the result byte back in the message, replies to the message unless its flag says otherwise, then permits multitasking again.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:DEVS/ramdrive.device:0:062C
name: return_minus_three_stub
description: Returns minus three without doing other work.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:DEVS/ramdrive.device:0:0718
name: expire_and_free_unit_node
description: Counts down a field in a unit record. When it expires on a linked unit, it unlinks the unit, frees its memory through Exec, removes its entry from the list, and appends a colon to the name buffer.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:DEVS/ramdrive.device:0:077C
name: detach_unit_name_with_colon
description: Copies a stored pointer into an output slot, removes a node from the device list, calls a library routine, appends a colon to the name at the address register, and calls Permit.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:DEVS/ramdrive.device:0:0790
name: terminate_string_with_colon
description: Copies a stored pointer into an output slot, calls a library routine, then walks the string at the address register to its terminating zero, replaces that zero with a colon, and calls Permit.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0000
name: return_minus_one_entry
description: Entry point of a shared library file that does nothing except return minus one.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:00B8
name: open_three_system_libraries
description: Stores a pointer in a structure, then opens the dos, graphics and intuition libraries through Exec calls, keeping each returned base in a global slot.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0104
name: release_structure_when_count_expires
description: Counts down a field in a structure. When the count reaches zero with a flag bit set, it releases the structure's library bases and memory through library calls and returns the stored pointer; otherwise it sets the flag when the count has expired and returns zero.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0116
name: release_resources_or_set_flag
description: When the structure's count is zero it releases its library bases and memory through library calls and returns the stored pointer. Otherwise it sets a deferred-release flag and returns zero.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0130
name: release_structure_resources
description: Releases a structure's resources through library calls, closing three libraries and freeing memory, then returns the pointer stored in the structure.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:01D0
name: call_one_routine_and_return
description: Calls one other routine and returns.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:01E2
name: unpack_powerpacker_stream
description: Decodes a PowerPacker-compressed stream by reading bit-coded lengths and offsets and copying literal bytes or earlier output bytes into the destination until the output start is reached.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0226
name: return_after_bit_test
description: Tests whether the upper bits of a register are set and returns in either case, doing nothing else.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:022C
name: return_no_op_library
description: Returns immediately without doing anything.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0234
name: shift_bit_buffer_backwards
description: Shifts a counted number of bits out of a bit buffer that refills backwards from memory, taking a new longword whenever the buffer empties.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0242
name: refill_backwards_bit_buffer
description: Refills a backward-reading bit buffer from memory and shifts out a counted number of bits, carrying the last bit shifted out into the extend flag.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0248
name: copy_back_references_to_output
description: Continues the PowerPacker decode loop by decoding match lengths and offsets, copying earlier output bytes or literal bytes into decreasing output addresses, and stopping when the output reaches its start.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:026E
name: decode_backward_match_loop
description: Runs a backward match loop over PowerPacker data, copying bytes into decreasing output addresses for the stored length, reading further literal or match codes, and returning when the output start is reached.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:029C
name: hash_string_with_rotation
description: Folds a zero-terminated byte string into a 16-bit value by rotating the running value by an amount taken from the previous byte and adding that byte.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:02B2
name: compute_rotating_checksum
description: Computes a 32-bit checksum over a zero-terminated byte string, rotating the accumulator by one bit and then by sixteen bits for each byte, and returns the accumulator.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:02C2
name: xor_block_with_key
description: XORs each 32-bit word of a block with a key, counting the block in longwords rounded up from its byte length.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:02D6
name: load_and_relocate_hunk_file
description: Loads an AmigaDOS executable's hunk sections into memory by allocating each hunk, copying its contents and applying its 32-bit relocation records, using Exec memory and library calls.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:02DA
name: load_hunk_sections_checked
description: When its first check passes it loads AmigaDOS hunk sections in the same way as the main hunk loader, applying relocations and finishing through library calls. Otherwise it returns immediately.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0304
name: load_hunk_sections_alternate
description: Reads AmigaDOS hunk headers into stack variables, loads each hunk's contents, applies its relocation records, and finishes by releasing temporary memory.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0324
name: load_hunk_sections_and_close
description: Loads AmigaDOS hunk sections like the other hunk loaders in this file, then finishes by releasing temporary memory and closing its library.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:036A
name: load_hunk_sections_from_header
description: Loads AmigaDOS hunk sections using a header block passed in the address register and a size argument, copies the header's trailing fields into the output, and finishes by releasing temporary memory and closing its library.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:03BA
name: dispatch_hunk_file_records
description: Walks the records of an AmigaDOS hunk file and dispatches each one. An end marker finishes the walk; other records allocate a hunk, copy its header, and load its data and relocations.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:03C6
name: allocate_and_load_hunk_records
description: Walks AmigaDOS hunk records, allocating memory for each code, data or BSS hunk through an Exec allocation call, loading its contents and applying its relocations, then releasing temporary memory.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0404
name: copy_hunk_contents_into_memory
description: Copies hunk data from the file buffer into freshly allocated memory through an Exec copy call, then processes the following hunk records and relocations.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0450
name: copy_hunk_block_then_free
description: Copies a block of longwords from the source buffer to the destination, releases a temporary buffer through an Exec call, and continues processing the hunk records.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0480
name: process_hunk_records_and_close
description: Processes the next AmigaDOS hunk records, allocating and loading each hunk's contents, then releases temporary memory and closes its library when the records end.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:04EA
name: apply_hunk_relocations
description: Applies 32-bit relocation records to the loaded hunks by adding the hunk base address to each longword named in the list. When the list ends it releases temporary memory and closes its library.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0500
name: count_down_word_counter
description: Steps a 16-bit counter from its current value down past zero, doing no other work, and returns after the counter wraps.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0514
name: finish_hunk_records_and_close
description: Handles the end of AmigaDOS hunk records: it copies trailing header fields when a flag is set, releases temporary memory through an Exec call, runs a further library call, and closes its library.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0570
name: write_powerpacker_header_tag
description: Writes a four-byte PowerPacker signature, a variant chosen by a flag, through a library write call. It returns the write result when the full tag was written, and zero otherwise.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0584
name: write_powerpacker_signature
description: Writes a four-byte PowerPacker signature, a variant chosen by a flag, through a library write call. It returns the write result when the full tag was written, and zero otherwise.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:059E
name: set_powerpacker_header
description: Writes the PowerPacker signature into a header structure, stores a value from a table indexed by the data register in the header, and calls a stored routine. It returns that routine's result when it matches the header address plus eight, and zero otherwise.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:05D2
name: open_library_or_call_fallback
description: Calls a library routine that opens a library. When that call returns non-zero, it returns the data register unchanged; otherwise it makes a second library call before returning the data register.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:05DC
name: open_library_fallback_two
description: Calls a library routine that opens a library. When that call returns non-zero, it returns the data register unchanged; otherwise it makes a second library call before returning the data register.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:05EA
name: open_library_fallback_three
description: Calls a library routine that opens a library. When that call returns non-zero, it returns the data register unchanged; otherwise it makes a second library call before returning the data register.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:05F4
name: open_reqtools_or_close
description: Opens reqtools.library through an Exec call. It returns the data register when the open succeeds, and otherwise calls a close-library stub before returning it.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0656
name: call_stored_hook_return_argument
description: Calls a function pointer taken from a global variable with no arguments, then returns its own argument unchanged.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:06AA
name: get_powerpacker_table_entry
description: Inverts the index in the data register, clamps it to at most 7, and returns the longword at that index in a global table.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0770
name: load_powerpacker_file_header
description: Copies a file name into a buffer, opens the file through library calls, reads its signature to identify PowerPacker data, handles the encrypted and password variants, and returns zero on success or a negative error code.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:07C2
name: open_powerpacker_file_with_retry
description: Copies a file name into a buffer and retries an open call through a library routine until it succeeds or a flag makes it stop. It then reads the file's signature and header, returning zero on success or a negative error code.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:07E4
name: read_powerpacker_file_header
description: Reads a PowerPacker file's signature and header fields from an already opened file, handling the plain, encrypted and password variants, and returns zero on success or a negative error code.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0806
name: verify_powerpacker_header_transfer
description: Reads back the file header through a library call and checks the transfer count against the expected length. On a match it records the output size and returns zero; otherwise it returns a negative error code.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0844
name: transfer_powerpacker_header_fields
description: Checks a transfer count and, for the four-byte header variant, reads the remaining fields and records the output size when the stored length matches, returning zero; otherwise it returns a negative error code.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0862
name: finish_powerpacker_stream_check
description: Calls a stored routine on the buffer, reads four more bytes, and checks the transfer count. On a match it records the output size and returns zero; otherwise it returns a negative error code.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:087C
name: check_powerpacker_stream_length
description: Calls a stored routine on the signature, reads the next longword, and when the stored length matches it records the unpacked size and returns zero. Otherwise it returns a negative error code.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:08A0
name: read_powerpacker_length_fields
description: Reads a packed-length longword from the file, checks the transfer count against the expected length, records the output size on success, and returns zero or a negative error code.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:08D8
name: write_powerpacker_chunk_checked
description: Shifts the stored size field, writes a chunk through a library call and, when the transfer count matches the expected length, records the output size and returns zero. Otherwise it returns a negative error code.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:08EA
name: adjust_powerpacker_expected_length
description: When its argument is minus one it reads a header size longword and steps the expected length back by twelve bytes. Otherwise it checks the signature and records the expected length, then writes through a library call and returns zero when the count matches, or a negative error code.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:08F4
name: check_powerpacker_transfer_count
description: Checks the stored signature for the packed-header variant, records the expected length, and writes through a library call. It returns zero when the transfer count matches, otherwise a negative error code.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0926
name: record_powerpacker_expected_length
description: Records the expected length in the file state, writes through a library call, and returns zero when the transfer count matches it, or a negative error code otherwise.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0948
name: finish_powerpacker_file_state
description: Checks a transfer count against the expected length and, for the variant selected by a flag, records the output size and releases temporary buffers through library calls. It returns zero on success, otherwise the stored error code.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:09D4
name: release_buffer_return_error
description: Releases a temporary buffer through an Exec call and returns the stored error code.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0AAC
name: release_three_routines_if_set
description: When its argument is non-zero, calls three other routines in turn. Otherwise it returns at once.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0AD2
name: allocate_powerpacker_decoder_state
description: Allocates a decoder state structure and fills it with the packing parameters chosen by a mode value, including block sizes, bit counts and lookup table sizes. It returns the structure, or nothing when an allocation fails.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0B00
name: initialise_powerpacker_decoder_state
description: Fills an existing decoder state structure with the packing parameters chosen by a mode value, then allocates its two working tables, calling a release routine if either allocation fails.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0B1C
name: initialise_fixed_powerpacker_state
description: Fills an existing decoder state structure with fixed packing parameters and allocates its two working tables, calling a release routine when an allocation fails.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0B24
name: initialise_powerpacker_state_bits
description: Fills an existing decoder state with a bit width taken from the argument and fixed table sizes, then allocates its two working tables, releasing them when an allocation fails.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0B2A
name: initialise_powerpacker_state_wide
description: Fills an existing decoder state with a bit width taken from the argument and larger fixed table sizes, then allocates its two working tables, releasing them if an allocation fails.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0B30
name: initialise_powerpacker_state_large
description: Fills an existing decoder state with a bit width taken from the argument and the largest fixed table sizes, then allocates its two working tables, releasing them if an allocation fails.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0BF2
name: return_nothing_stub
description: Does nothing and returns.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0BFC
name: store_powerpacker_buffer_bounds
description: Stores a start pointer and length in a structure, records the end address as their sum, then calls another routine and returns.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0C24
name: find_powerpacker_matches
description: Clears two work tables, then scans the input for repeated byte sequences, storing the best match length and offset for each position and calling a progress callback after every 512 bytes.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0CB4
name: find_powerpacker_matches_from_stack
description: Records the start position from the stack argument, then runs the repeated-sequence search, storing the best match length and offset for each position and calling a progress callback after every 512 bytes.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0CBE
name: find_powerpacker_matches_at_register
description: Runs the repeated-sequence search from the position in the address register, storing the best match length and offset for each position and calling a progress callback after every 512 bytes.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0D36
name: resume_powerpacker_match_search
description: Resumes the repeated-sequence search from a saved position, storing the best match length and offset for each position and reporting progress through a callback.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0DC8
name: emit_powerpacker_token
description: Writes one packed token to the output: a literal is written through a bit routine, and a match is written as length and offset codes with its table entries cleared, then the output position advances.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0DD8
name: emit_powerpacker_token_mode_one
description: Writes one packed token for the mode-one format, clearing the match table entries it uses and returning the output position.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0E6A
name: finish_powerpacker_token_stream
description: Writes the remaining packed tokens of the block, clearing the match tables for the rest of the block, and returns the final output status.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0E72
name: emit_powerpacker_tokens_from_stack
description: Writes packed tokens for the block using the stack argument as the start position, clearing the table entries of each emitted match until the block is complete.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0F06
name: emit_powerpacker_tokens_to_pointer
description: Writes packed tokens for the block into the output pointer given as its first argument, clearing the table entries of each emitted match, and returns the status with the final output position.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0F26
name: emit_powerpacker_literal_run
description: Writes a run of literal tokens from the current position, clearing their table entries, and stops when the output reaches the block end.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0F38
name: finish_powerpacker_token_block
description: Writes the remaining tokens of the block and then the final control value through a library routine, returning the output position and status.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0F6E
name: emit_powerpacker_match_run
description: Writes a run of match tokens into the output, clearing table entries and reporting progress through a callback, then returns the status.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0F9A
name: emit_powerpacker_literal_or_match
description: Writes the next packed token for the block, choosing a literal or a match, clearing the matched table entries, and returns the output status.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0FA8
name: emit_powerpacker_tokens_with_search
description: Writes packed tokens while searching for the next match in the block, storing lengths and offsets as it goes, and returns when the block is complete.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:0FBC
name: emit_powerpacker_literal_token
description: Writes one literal token and advances the output, then finishes the block when no input remains, returning the output status.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:100A
name: emit_powerpacker_match_token
description: Writes a match token from the search results, advancing the output, and finishes the block when the output reaches the block end.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:1016
name: emit_powerpacker_zero_byte_token
description: Clears one table entry and advances the output, then finishes the block when the output reaches its end, returning the status.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:1036
name: emit_powerpacker_packed_run
description: Writes a run of packed tokens from the current position, choosing literal or match coding by the packing mode, and returns the output status once the block is complete.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:1086
name: emit_powerpacker_tail_token
description: Writes a final packed token and returns the output status when the block is finished.

key: combat air patrol (1992)(psygnosis)[cr xpress]/Combat Air Patrol (1992)(Psygnosis)[cr Xpress].adf:libs/powerpacker.library:0:108C
name: emit_powerpacker_zero_run
description: Clears a run of table entries from the current position, writes the zero-filled remainder of the output, then returns the status.
